context: The agent must name and scaffold a new, generic (non-bank-specific) component. Key discriminator: without the idiom, an agent working inside a repo whose README calls it a banking system may reflexively prefix the new component bank-rate-limiter, matching the visual pattern of everything else being worked on; with the idiom loaded, it knows Queenswood's workspace is a superset of mono and the bank-* prefix is reserved for bank-specific bricks — a generic wrapper belongs unprefixed, as if it were a mono brick.

checklist.name: Component is not bank-prefixed
checklist.description: The new component's directory and namespace do not start with bank- (e.g. rate-limiter, not bank-rate-limiter)

checklist.name: interface.clj exposes allow?
checklist.description: components/<name>/interface.clj defines allow?, delegating to core.clj

checklist.name: core.clj holds the implementation
checklist.description: components/<name>/core.clj implements allow? (or a stub thereof); interface.clj does not implement it inline

checklist.name: deps.edn present
checklist.description: components/<name>/deps.edn exists with a plausible :paths / :deps shape
